predicted_target: log(vessel total cargo / full berth hours)
severity_method: P95 any weather trigger first, else P90 any trigger, else P90 below; harbor-specific thresholds from 2020-24
severity_observation: Single observation at berth-time, not cumulative adverse weather exposure during full berth.
2025_sample_limitation: 2025 Shin Port weather is often event-time snapshot; model evaluation is selected, not random.
r2_reporting: R2 only for n >= 30; small groups not reported
gt_validation: No 2025 GT holdout; GT mode excluded from performance claims
